speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; to better understand your condition, have you noticed excessive bleeding from minor cuts or gums prior to this procedure?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A or B. The combination of hemarthrosis (joint swelling) in the patient's uncle, easy bruising, and severe post-extraction bleeding strongly suggests an X-linked coagulation factor deficiency. I need to confirm the specific factor deficiency and severity. REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT, Factor VIII, Factor IX. REQUEST IMAGES: X-ray of the patient's right knee to assess for joint hemarthrosis or chronic damage.
